mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Supplement_Record_Dtl mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Ses_Id = #{id}

select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as exContrAbbName, c1.C_Name_History as cNameHistory, mn.*, se.* from Sec_Expert_Shield mn left join Sec_Expert se on mn.Ex_Id = se.Ex_Id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = se.C_Id where mn.Sr_Id = #{srId}

select es.Es_Technology_Num as esTechnologyNum, es.Es_Economics_Num as esEconomicsNum, es.Es_Expert_Num as esExpertNum, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, pro.P_Approve_Budget as pApproveBudget, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Remark as secRemark, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Evaluate_Separation as secEvaluateSeparation, sec.Sec_Quali_Review as secQualiReview, sec.Sec_Bid_Time as secBidTime, sec.Sec_Loaction as secLoaction, sec.Sec_Investors_Quali as secInvestorsQuali, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sd.D_Function as dFunction, sd.D_Scope as dScope, sd.D_Executive_Standard as dExecutiveStandard, sd.D_Amount as dAmount, sd.D_Bid_Time as dBidTime, sd.D_Location as dLocation, c1.C_Name as secTendereeName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c3.C_Name as esCompanyName, mn.id as id, mn.Sr_Id as srId, sr.*, es.*, mn.* from Sec_Expert_Supplement mn left join Sec_Selection_Record sr on mn.Sr_Id = sr.Sr_Id left join Sec_Expert_Select es on es.id = sr.Es_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = es.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = es.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = es.Es_Company left join Sec_Document sd on sd.Sec_Id = sec.Sec_Id and sd.D_State = 7 where mn.id = #{id}
